description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wathuragama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511002
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels of land in the Gampaha District. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
